scope: Read-only independent source review of new boon readout and deterministic event previews, plus one validator-accepted ward-cap transition probe. Existing unit modules were read, not re-run here; full gates are deferred until root freezes code.

reviewedContracts.finding: Floor blessing/event power/event luck survive retry and clear on descent; pending nextLuck clears on roll/retry/descent. Reserve echo/ward is consumed at actual combat entry. Readout conditions match those authoritative branches.
The readout distinguishes raw temporary contribution and rounded effective whole-build luck; it calls stats for the latter and does not add raw points directly to effective luck.
Preview uses floor rounding for 10%/35% shield and 35% healing, preserves larger current ward and caps HP exactly as applyEvent.
Preview uses stored prices, exact 20/30 temporary caps, and stats of a detached next-state copy for effective luck. Disabled choices return no after-state.
Preview follows the stored target ID, increments pactScars, respects item level cap/XP clearing, and uses stats on detached updated equipment for permanent max-HP and current-HP clipping.
Preview uses stored target and offer IDs, shows exactly one item removed and at most +2 enhancement; contradictory same-target/offer reference returns no invented upgrade preview.
Immediate event preview reports gold and reserve flags without prematurely granting combat damage or shield. At next entry, the existing engine still owns actual reward application.
New model functions do not invoke transitions, random APIs, reward generation or storage writes; returned quote rows/groups are detached display data.

findings.description: A legal ward=1e15 state consumes a paid ward reserve on next combat entry but receives zero net ward because health() caps total ward. Expanded readout should mention the existing cap. No engine change is needed; immediate event quote is already correct.
